text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though victory eluded her,
<chrname> put on a 
magnificent showing. Public expectations 
soared to new heights.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, it was also clear that winning 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe under these 
conditions would be difficult.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The members gathered at the gym. In order 
to shore up the weaknesses exposed in the 
Prix Niel, they resumed training as one 
united front.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A victory in the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe,
once called a pipe dream—the day 
to fulfill Japan's long-cherished wish
was fast approaching.
